cleanup_budget_policy: Budget assumption: the 48-hour limit counts GPU model search, including tool use and candidate verification. Under this assumption CPU cleanup is separate postprocessing. If CPU postprocessing must count within 48 hours, omit cleanup with --no-cleanup and use verified model proofs; CPU-only execution does not automatically waive a wall-clock limit.
cleanup_allocation_policy: Inline cleanup retains the GPU reservation. To release GPUs first: run-namespace.sh WORK OUTPUT --no-cleanup, end the GPU allocation, then PROOF_EVAL_FILESYSTEM_BACKEND=readonly-mounts bash cleanup.sh WORK OUTPUT in a separate CPU allocation.

native_host_requirements.configuration: CONFIG_SECURITY_LANDLOCK=y and landlock enabled in the active LSM list
native_host_requirements.kernel_reference: Mainline Linux >=6.2 or equivalent ABI-3 backport; query the actual ABI
native_host_requirements.example_host: Ubuntu 24.04, Linux 6.8, Landlock enabled, required container syscalls permitted

native_host_requirements.unsupported_host_policy: Fail closed with selected backend; no automatic fallback or removed protections
native_host_requirements.organizer_current_NERSC_host: Default Landlock incompatible per organizer; alternative requires actual compute-container preflight

explicit_alternative.container_profile: The tested non-privileged EPFL container permits nested user/mount namespaces using outer seccomp and AppArmor Unconfined; inner native restrictions remain mandatory
